base.scope: UI/knowledge/chat control, source parsing, bounded H5AD registration/profile, process controls; does not qualify scientific analysis execution.

analysis.scope: Default complete CPU host: base plus current trusted analysis worker preparation and artifact validation. Fitting wrappers still require separately qualified runtime packs.

version_policy: Reuse the existing tested direct pins and official isolated psutil5.9.8 wheel. These files are not a complete transitive hash lock; do not resolve latest direct versions or call metadata in the mixed global environment a clean installation.

direct_dependency_reasons.streamlit: UI render library; importing is not launching the server.
direct_dependency_reasons.pydantic: Workbench and legacy typed scientific contracts.
direct_dependency_reasons.cryptography: Credential vault plus runtime-pack signature verification.
direct_dependency_reasons.python-dotenv: Explicit credential reference parsing; no SDK needed for HTTP transport.
direct_dependency_reasons.pypdf: Local PDF parser, loaded on demand.
direct_dependency_reasons.psutil: Chat owner identity, code-process controls and scientific subprocess cleanup/RSS.
direct_dependency_reasons.h5py: H5AD signature, external-link and bounded profile checks in DatasetService.
direct_dependency_reasons.numpy: Bounded matrix profile; also a Streamlit/AnnData dependency.
direct_dependency_reasons.anndata: Trusted analysis worker reads backed H5AD and validates saved scientific artifacts in the same Python as control plane.
direct_dependency_reasons.scipy: Trusted analysis preparation and engine.data_intelligence sparse matrices.
direct_dependency_reasons.pandas: Representative preview and eagerly imported integration validator.
direct_dependency_reasons.scikit-learn: execution.local_user_service imports IntegrationValidator at module import, which imports sklearn.metrics even for the current Scrublet host path.

interpreter_boundary.trusted_worker: sckg_workbench/analysis.py:_execute_supervised launches [sys.executable, -m, sckg_workbench.analysis]. Lazy imports defer work but do not move it to another interpreter.
interpreter_boundary.fitting_runtime: execution/wrapper_registry.py:WrapperDefinition.command selects python_executable or RuntimePackResolver.python(runtime_pack_id). Scrublet0.2.3 stays unchanged; no scanpy/torch/CellTypist/model weights are added here.
not_qualified_by_dependency_probe: Clean install without root installation and wheel receipts

installation_strategy.preferred_for_existing_python: A new venv with include-system-site-packages=false, no PYTHONPATH/user-site/overlay inheritance, then wheel-only install of this product requirements layer.
installation_strategy.independent_python_alternative: Reuse the existing pinned micromamba2.8.1 and explicit Python3.12.13 bootstrap into a fresh dedicated prefix; use the new Workbench requirements instead of the historical full-agent pip lock.
installation_strategy.why_not_existing_installer_unchanged: The historical manifest targets app.py and requirements.txt, including legacy LLM/scientific packages and psutil5.9.0. Its downloader/hash/explicit-prefix pattern is reusable; its application/dependency set is not this new product lock.
root_only_next_preflight: Freeze official URL/bytes/hash and install/download resource budget before downloading.
Resolve a new full transitive wheel set for the target Python/platform, freeze hashes and bytes in the new evidence package.
Install to a fresh prefix with wheel-only/no source build; prefer --no-index plus the frozen wheelhouse and --require-hashes once the actual lock exists.
Run pip check and the dependency qualifier under the existing wall/RSS supervisor, followed by actual product journey tests.
installation_strategy.freshness_rule: A new dedicated prefix is required for clean-install evidence. A venv with --system-site-packages or an existing Conda/overlay environment is not clean; this probe reports clean_install_claim=false even on pass until installation receipts establish provenance.

qualification_scope: Metadata/isolation, direct import origins, actual _execute import prelude, AnalysisService construction, typed Scrublet contract load, tiny synthetic HDF5 profile, and pip check. No model/network, task dispatch, scientific fit, UI/server, or install.
platform_boundary: Current application uses POSIX fcntl and process-group semantics. A new prefix on this macOS arm64 host is the immediate target; do not claim Windows or other platform qualification.
g5_boundary: Requirements and successful import probes alone do not pass portable product delivery; actual fresh install, complete locked transitives, resource measurements and product journeys must still be recorded.
